title: Harvest Moon - Friends of Mineral Town (USA)

fields.name: magic_header_stamp
fields.update_mechanism: Flushed verbatim from a RAM buffer (_DAT_08000398) to SRAM offset 0x00 by FUN_08000358 via the FUN_080006a4 write-verify driver; never constructed or mutated byte-by-byte by any traced function, only copied as a fixed block.
fields.evidence: Identical 0x20-byte span used by writer call (func_0x080006a4(param_1,0,_DAT_08000398,0x20)), reader call (func_0x080006e4(param_1,auStack_34,0,0x20)) and memcmp call (func_0x080d3948(auStack_34,_DAT_08000354,0x20)); bytes present verbatim in saves/cap-00-future-0.sav offsets 0x00-0x1F.

fields.name: stamp_a
fields.update_mechanism: Writer re-reads the just-completed header write's status code (0 = success) and writes that same value as 4 bytes at offset 0x20. Reader requires (value & 3) == value, i.e. value in {0,1,2,3}. Only one all-zero sample is available, so it is unconfirmed whether this field ever takes on a real counter/slot-index role versus always being a plain 0/success echo.
fields.evidence: ghidra/decompiled.c FUN_08000358 (write) and FUN_080002e0 (range-check read); saves/cap-00-future-0.sav bytes 0x20-0x23 = 00000000, which satisfies the predicate (verified via Python: (0 & 3) == 0 -> True).

fields.name: stamp_b
fields.update_mechanism: Written with the identical value as stamp_a, at offset 0x24, only if the stamp_a write also reported success. Reader requires value < 2, i.e. value in {0,1}.
fields.evidence: ghidra/decompiled.c FUN_08000358 (write) and FUN_080002e0 (range-check read); saves/cap-00-future-0.sav bytes 0x24-0x27 = 00000000, which satisfies the predicate (verified via Python: 0 < 2 -> True).

fields.name: unmapped_data_region
fields.update_mechanism: Unknown; no function in the available 214-function decompilation reads or writes this range. Hypothesized to hold actual gameplay save data (farm/character/calendar/inventory state) given the total 32KB SRAM size versus the tiny 40-byte header region, but this is unverified.
fields.evidence: saves/hexdump_and_diffs.txt shows only one active range (0x0000-0x0028); saves/cap-00-future-0.sav bytes 0x28 onward are all 0xFF, consistent with an untouched/cold save.
